candidates.excerpt: The Telangana Assembly Ethics Committee deferred its decision on Huzurabad MLA Padi Kaushik Reddy and asked him to submit his explanation by October 7. The panel will reconvene on October 8 after providing requested raw video footage.

candidates.title: Property offender involved in 270 cases held with Meth, LSD in Shamshabad
candidates.excerpt: Shamshabad police arrested three persons, including a man reportedly involved in around 270 property offence cases, in a drug peddling case. They seized 80 grams of Meth, four LSD blots and four mobile phones, while two suspects remain absconding.

candidates.title: No relief for Hemant Soren in PMLA case from Jharkhand HC, next hearing on Oct 20
candidates.excerpt: In a setback to Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren, the High Court on Wednesday refused to give him any relief in a PMLA case linked to 8.86 acres of land in Ranchi’s Bargain revenue circle.
